subject: dsa
title: Copy List With Random Pointer
summary: Deep-copy a list whose nodes carry an extra random pointer.
problem: Deep-copy a linked list where each node also has a random pointer to any node. The O(1)-space trick weaves each copy right after its original, sets the copies' random pointers, then unweaves the two lists. Here the list is 1 -> 2 -> 3, each node also holding a random pointer.

steps.caption: Deep-copy a list whose nodes also have random pointers. Weave each copy right after its original.
Insert each copy after its original, giving 1 -> 1' -> 2 -> 2' -> 3 -> 3'.
Set each copy's random pointer. It is the copy of the original's random target, which sits one node to its right.
Unweave the lists, separating the copies into their own chain. The extracted copy is fully independent.
The deep copy 1 -> 2 -> 3 is complete with its own random pointers.
